# Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - March 12, 2026

> 日期: 2026-03-12 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2026/03

## Hotfix Update

This is a bug fix patch. Replay codes from March 10, 2026 patch are still available.

## Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that resulted in Jetpack Cat's Claws Out Perk cooldown being 8 seconds instead of the intended 6 seconds. Fixed an issue that caused some Knockbacks or Pulls to have reduced distances.
